picks.title: 克拉拉与太阳
picks.summary: 改编自石黑一雄的同名小说。人工智能机器人克拉拉被设计用于陪伴青少年，防止他们变得孤独。一名母亲和聪明但患有神秘疾病的乔茜买下它，克拉拉帮助这个家庭度过心碎时期，也在此过程中认识到人类爱的力量。
picks.summaryEn: An Artificial Friend named Klara finds a deep bond with a troubled young girl, bringing light and hope to a grieving family through her unwavering devotion and innocent wonder.

picks.title: 荒野丛林

picks.title: 黑球
picks.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
picks.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
